name: SSC
notes: SSC's application module on ssc.gov.in now captures the photograph LIVE through your webcam or phone camera - a stored photo cannot be uploaded, and doing so is grounds for rejection.
These dimensions remain useful for offline needs (admit-card printouts, document sets, other commissions), not for the SSC upload itself.
The signature is still a separate upload: JPEG, 10-20 KB, black ink on white paper.
Recent passport-style photo, no cap, mask or spectacles.
